events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Carson Kelly hit his second career grand slam in Chicago’s seven-run first inning and finished with a career-high six RBI as the Cubs routed the Toronto Blue Jays 16-2 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Kelly has grand slam and career-high 6 RBIs as Cubs rout Blue Jays 16-2

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal struck out eight while pitching into the sixth inning, and Matt Vierling and Kerry Carpenter hit home runs to help lift the Detroit Tigers past the Chicago White Sox 4-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skubal fans 8, Vierling and Carpenter homer as the Tigers beat the White Sox 4-3

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Cam Schlittler struck out 13 in six overpowering innings for his first double-digit strikeout game in the regular season, and the New York Yankees beat the Cincinnati Reds 5-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Schlittler strikes out career-high 13 in 6 innings as Yankees blank Reds 5-0

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Owen Caissie was a triple shy of the cycle and hit a go-ahead sacrifice fly as the Miami Marlins beat the San Francisco Giants 4-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caissie homers, doubles and singles to lead Marlins to 4-3 win over Giants

events.name: Washington Nationals at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Washington Nationals center fielder Jacob Young left Saturday’s game against the Tampa Bay Rays in the eighth inning after crashing into the outfield wall.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals' Jacob Young leaves game after crashing into outfield wall

headlines.description: — Jacob Misiorowski lost for the first time in two months as the Atlanta Braves scored two runs against the Milwaukee Brewers’ ace and Mike Yastrzemski hit a home run in a 3-2 victory in the first game of a three-game series between NL division...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob Misiorowski tagged for 2 runs by Mauricio Dubón and Braves beat Brewers 3-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom struck out nine over six innings to win on his 38th birthday, even after giving up a grand slam to Ty France in the first, and the Texas Rangers beat the San Diego Padres 9-7 in a wild series opener Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeGrom has 9 Ks to win on his 38th birthday as Rangers get wild 9-7 victory over Padres

headlines.description: — Jose Altuve hit a three-run home run, Jeremy Peña had two solo shots and the Houston Astros beat the Cleveland Guardians 9-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jose Altuve, Jeremy Peña power the Astros past the Guardians, 9-3

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Jac Caglianone hit a home run and drove in two as the Kansas City Royals beat the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 Friday night to clinch the three-game series and snap a three-series losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caglianone, Lugo lead Royals past Cardinals 6-5, to clinch series

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Braxton Fulford had a go-ahead two-run double with two outs in the eighth inning, Antonio Senzatela got out of a bases-loaded jam with no outs in the ninth and the Colorado Rockies held on for a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulford's pinch 2-run double in 8th lifts Rockies past Pirates 4-3, Freeland reaches 1,000 Ks

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Jonah Heim launched a tying homer with two outs in the ninth and the Athletics allowed 11 straight runs before rallying from seven down to defeat the Los Angeles Angels 12-11 in 10 innings Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heim's pinch-hit HR in 9th helps A's complete huge comeback for 12-11 win over Angels in 10 innings

headlines.description: — Corbin Carroll had a three-run triple in the eighth inning to tie Arizona's career triples mark and fell a homer shy of the cycle in the Diamondbacks' 9-5 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carroll has a 3-run triple in the 8th to help the Diamondbacks beat the Twins 9-5

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Dalton Rushing singled in the tying run and a throwing error by Tyler O'Neill scored the go-ahead run in the bottom of the ninth inning, helping the Los Angeles Dodgers rally past the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 on Friday night in the series opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: A ninth-inning throwing error lifts the Dodgers past the Orioles 6-5

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Ranger Suarez carried a no-hitter into the seventh inning and the Boston Red Sox beat the Seattle Mariners 6-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ranger Suarez takes no-hitter into 7th inning as Red Sox top Mariners 6-2
